description: The overnight rebalance job failed partway through and didn't finish planning orders for the morning shift.

comments.author: ren.okafor
comments.body: Getting paged is exactly what's supposed to happen when the nightly rebalance fails, and that's what happened here. Per the runbook, ops on-call hand-reruns a failed nightly rebalance before 06:00, so I kicked it off manually and the vans went out on schedule.
